issues.title: Improve error handling when extracted library is corrupted
issues.body: If the processed libraries in .fabric get corrupted, the game will mysteriously crash on startup and blame a mod using the library instead. It'd be nice to have a runtime check to make sure everything is where it should be, if possible within the limitations of Fabric.

issues.title: Very Slow Rendering
issues.body: My rendering become very very slow, its meybe like 1 chunk for 10 seconds

issues.title: Any mod that requires Fabric Language Kotlin that I have will not work.
issues.body: When I try to load any version of Kotlin on a mod that requires it, it crashes the game when I try to start it, not even giving me an error message from the Fabric Loader. It seems the problem only surfaced when I started using 26.2.

issues.title: Suggestion: Include a stub kotlin mod
issues.body: Just like how loader provides a stub `java` mod so we can depend on a specific java version, can a similar thing be provided in this mod so we can depend on a specific kotlin version rather than FLK directly? Probably more of a nice to have rather than an essential addition.

The mod appears in the normal Modmenu list, even if library mods are hidden.

"custom": {

issues.title: Bundle Kotlinx Serialization into library
issues.body:
I'd like to see Kotlinx Serialization bundled into Fabric Language Kotlin. I've preferred to use that over Gson for a lot of things, and it works better for Kotlin as it currently stands.

The 0.4.X loader page on nested Jars says this library should probably be bundled into a mod, since it probably couldn't be repackaged and multiple mods would use it.

As such, this way we don't have to rely on multiple third party mods (which may have wider scopes than just including the library, and are not up to date).

This would include both the Serialization library as well as it's JSON library.
